findings.suggested_change: Subject to the overall liability cap set forth herein, each party's total liability for loss or damage to real property or tangible personal property shall be limited to direct damages proven.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose one small adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, property damage claims caused by negligence are currently excluded from the overall liability cap, and I propose modifying it so that subject to the overall liability cap set forth herein, each party's total liability for loss or damage to real property or tangible personal property shall be limited to direct damages proven. Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
